preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.
The number of points to visit in each test case is between 1 and 200,000.
The layer number of each point is between 1 and 1,000,000,000.
The point number in its layer is between 1 and the layer number.

preconditions.expression: There is always at least one way to traverse all points.
preconditions.description: A path exists that visits all points.

preconditions.expression: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5.
preconditions.description: The total number of points across all test cases does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.expression: Output the minimum cost of a path passing through all points in the corresponding test case.
postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum cost to visit all points starting from (1, 1) and ending at each point in the order given, considering the cost of flipping edges.
